observations: Black professional hair steamer hanging from a white metal bracket.
Control panel on the top of the unit features two rotary knobs and a power indicator light.
A clear plastic water tank is attached to the front of the steamer.
The unit is shown in a salon or commercial setting with other equipment visible.
Watermarks 'NEXUS BEAUTY MAKEOVERS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all photos.

No photos show the unit powered on or steam flowing.

risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on with steam escaping from the nozzle.

risks.risk: The water tank may be cracked or leaking.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the water tank with the unit powered off.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the power cord and the plug at the end.

proof_requests: Video of the hair steamer powered on and producing steam.
Photo of the water tank to check for cracks.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
